component.name: Fathom
component.summary: A modern Jellyfin client with a built-in YouTube player

description.p: Fathom is a desktop Jellyfin client built with Flutter and media_kit (libmpv), so playback is mpv-grade: direct play with transcode fallback, proper subtitle and audio track handling, and hardware decoding.

ul.li: Movies and TV: libraries, search, resume, next-up, skip intro/credits, chapters, trickplay previews
Music: albums, queue, now playing, shuffle and repeat
Live TV and DVR: channel list, EPG guide, recording, series rules
YouTube: search, subscriptions, playlists, comments, chapters, a play queue, and downloads, with no account and no ads
Seerr: discovery and requests, when Jellyseerr is connected
Server administration: users, libraries, tasks, sessions, plugins

description.p: Beta: full interface internationalization, refined player chrome, and desktop pop-out.
